name: Khiamniungan Naga
notes: Skeleton. Tibeto-Burman (Sino-Tibetan) language of Nagaland/Myanmar, Latin roman orthography. Lexical tone (marked in gold by pitch numerals) is NOT orthographically recoverable and is left unencoded, so a high PER floor is expected. Digraphs ch/sh/ts and aspirate kh/ph/th mapped; vowel-diacritic tone marks are treated as their base vowel. Khiamniungan is tonal (Weidert 1987); lexical tone, not stress, carries prosodic prominence and is not recoverable from the Latin orthography, so it is left unencoded (documented exemption).
